title.en: Evaluate source Langmuir frequency and damping asymptotics.

summary: Evaluate source Langmuir frequency and damping asymptotics.

identity.definition: Logarithmic evaluation of the damping amplitude avoids the upstream 0/0 form when k³ underflows. Exact k=0 is rejected.
identity.direction: Declared inputs to declared scientific outputs
identity.coordinates: Dimensionless real velocity and complex phase or frequency
identity.boundary: Infinite real velocity contour with stated continuation or finite support.
assumptions: Maxwellian normalized thermal standard deviation and plasma frequency equal one.
Asymptotic use requires k much smaller than one.

supported: Positive small wavenumbers, including exponentially underflowed damping returned as zero.
excluded: Exact finite-k roots or a controlled global asymptotic remainder.
preconditions: Maxwellian normalized thermal standard deviation and plasma frequency equal one.
Asymptotic use requires k much smaller than one.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for invalid, nonfinite or singular declared inputs.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Callback arithmetic failures propagate; nonrepresentable transform raises ValueError.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: RuntimeError for Cauchy, real-axis or principal-value quadrature nonconvergence, or root nonconvergence.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial scientific result is returned after failure.

provenance.lineage_summary: Reimplements the defining scientific relations exposed by frozen GPDF D1; D2 corrections and failure history are documented in gpdf-generalized-core evaluation. Dev9 successor of exact document SHA256 6b4131e5ef5775f33ee89d24081fdf64d516a1565aa6709555f334c170efc9c2; unchanged contracts are reused, changed numerical methods and failure closure follow GPDF-R1/R2/R3.
provenance.license_status: Independent equation implementation uses NumPy and SciPy; their licenses are carried with the selected distribution.
public_references: Hua-Sheng Xie, Generalized plasma dispersion function, Phys. Plasmas. 20 (2013), 092125 (scientific context)

scope: Positive small wavenumbers, including exponentially underflowed damping returned as zero.
known_limitations: Finite outputs at large k do not imply asymptotic validity.
Damping smaller than floating representation underflows to zero.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Independent defining integrals, analytic residues, distributional jumps, all four complete default scans and 50-digit independent root equations are source-level numerical evidence. Actual installed-wheel evidence is recorded separately in the frozen delivery receipts.

example.description: Langmuir 小波数渐近频率的可执行例子
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.generalized_dispersion import evaluate_gpdf_small_k
r=evaluate_gpdf_small_k(.1)
assert abs(r['omega_real']-1.015)<1e-14
assert r['omega_imag']<0
example.expected: Assertions verify the stated output property.
